constructor: 2 group(s) route less than 100% of their flow_to_det to detritus; the remainder is treated as export out of the system: 5 (Sei whales), 4 (Brydes whales).

TE: 5 group(s) have near-zero TE (0 < EE << 1): 11 (Seabirds), 9 (Killer whales), 8 (Sperm whales), 7 (Beaked whales), 5 (Sei whales). Their SPPR is near-singular (inherent to the TE method); the detritus SPPR may be inflated and is not corrected by fix_EE_0_cases.
